# Privacy policy
Last updated August 28, 2026. This page restates the shop policy for www.cnps.ai. The shop store remains the checkout surface.

CNPS.AI operates the store and related website services to provide a curated shopping experience. The store is powered by Shopify. The shop Privacy Policy describes how personal information is collected, used, and disclosed when you visit, use, or make a purchase.
Categories may include contact details, financial and payment information, account information, transaction information, communications, device information, and usage information. Sources include information you provide, automatic collection through the services, service providers, and partners.
Uses described on the shop include providing and improving the services, marketing and advertising, security and fraud prevention, communicating with you, and legal reasons. Information may be disclosed to Shopify, vendors, marketing partners, affiliates, or in connection with legal process or a business transaction.
The services are not intended to be used by children. International transfers may occur. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, delete, correct, port, or opt out of certain selling or sharing for targeted advertising. Global Privacy Control is recognized as described on the shop policy.
Privacy contacts published on the shop: iweibing@gmail.com, +86 400 088 0546, Yunhe Road 336, Dongying, Shandong 257091, China.
Full text: shop privacy policy. Shopify consumer privacy: privacy.shopify.com.
